source_files: https://huggingface.co/datasets/KratosWen/IMPACT/resolve/main/v1.1/videos/IMPACT-v1.1-videos-ego.zip (two stored members read by HTTP range)
note: Each example is one ego trial's AF-S annotation file: label vocabularies, then per-hand segments (entity left/right) with a verb-noun action label, start/end frame (24.917 fps; timeline = frame/fps), a phase (normal, anomaly, recovery) and a 6-way anomaly-type vector (temporal, spatial, handling, wrong part, wrong tool, procedural). Timeline lanes: 'mistake' = anomaly, 'correction' = recovery, 'action' = normal non-null. Example 2's raw keeps the first 60 of 138 action_labels entries to stay under 25 KB.

examples.title: ER10WE06_Disassembly_A_003 (ego): angle-grinder disassembly — handling, temporal and spatial anomalies, one recovery
